legend: Strong cytoplasmic positivity for KIT (CD117) in gastrointestinal stromal tumour (ICC, KIT [CD117]).
Nuclear SOX10 positivity in schwannoma (ICC, SOX10).
Strong membranous CD99 positivity in Ewing sarcoma (ICC, CD99).

title: Immunocytochemical markers in soft tissue cytopathology
tablehtml:
Category

 

 

Marker

Soft tissue tumours

Localization

Comments

Tissue differentiation

 

 

Keratins

·     Epithelioid sarcoma, extrarenal rhabdoid tumour

·     Synovial sarcoma

·     Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumour with glandular differentiation

·     Chordoma

·     Myoepithelial neoplasm

·     Desmoplastic small round cell tumour

·     Pseudomyogenic haemangioendothelioma and vascular tumours with epithelioid morphology

·     Fibroblastic reticulum cell sarcoma (subset)

·     Many soft tissue tumours, especially with epithelioid morphology

Cytoplasmic

·     Used in ICC panels to differentiate metastatic carcinoma from high-grade sarcoma

·     May be seen in several high-grade sarcomas and soft tissue neoplasms with epithelioid morphology

SMA, muscle actin, calponin, h-caldesmon

Immunocytochemical marker(s)

CD34, CD31, ERG

Keratin, EMA, S100, GFAP, p63 (40%)

S100, GFAP, SOX10

EMA, CD34, claudin-1

Osteoblastic

SATB2

Melanocytic

S100, SOX10, melan-A (MART1), HMB45

Histiocytic

CD68, CD163, PU.1
